subject: Can you review your info on True Joy Birthing, Atlanta?
body:
Hi,

I added Atlanta Doula Services and Birth Classes to our Atlanta birth support page and wanted to ask for your help. You can see the page here:

https://truejoybirthing.com/birth-support/atlanta-ga/

I noticed your team has been serving Atlanta families for over 9 years with 700+ happy families, and that you offer Lamaze birth classes tailored specifically to families giving birth in the Atlanta area. The overnight postpartum doula care so parents can actually rest while they recover is such a valuable service.

There is no charge for being included on the page. I'd really appreciate it if you could take a look and let me know if anything needs fixing, not just your own info, but anything on the page that doesn't seem right for Atlanta. You'd know the local birth landscape better than I would, and the more accurate this page is, the easier it is for Atlanta moms to find the right birth support for them.

If anything needs to be changed, you can reply here and I'll update it. Once you've had a chance to review it, I can also mark your info as verified so families know it has been checked by you.

No pressure at all, I just appreciate any help making the page better.

Thanks,
Shelbi
True Joy Birthing, 104 E 600 S, #519, Heber City, UT 84032

If you don't want me to email you again, just let me know.
